entry: No dimension and no portal. Galosphere is an Overworld underground-generation mod, so 'entry' means finding the Crystal Canyons, not lighting anything.
Crystal Canyons generate all around the Overworld but the guide says they are COMMONEST IN COLD BIOMES (GgsFnDhMBc0). That is the practical 'how do I get there' fact for a questbook.
The metal ore generates deep - the guide gives Y -63 to 8.

VERSION WARNING - the guide is for 1.19 and says SILVER throughout. In the 1.20.1 jar (Galosphere 1.5.2) there is NO silver item at all: the ore, ingot, nugget, block and bomb are all PALLADIUM. galosphere:palladium_ore, galosphere:palladium_ingot, galosphere:raw_palladium, galosphere:palladium_bomb. Every 'silver' statement below has been remapped to palladium against the jar.
boss_order: NO bosses. This mod has no boss ladder at all - it is materials, mobs and utility blocks. A generated questline must not invent one.
order: FIRST: find a Crystal Canyon (cold biomes) and mine galosphere:palladium_ore, smelting to galosphere:palladium_ingot.

THEN the armour: sterling gear is NOT crafted from scratch. You add one ingot to an existing LEATHER armour piece in a SMITHING TABLE. That gives galosphere:sterling_helmet, galosphere:sterling_chestplate, galosphere:sterling_leggings, galosphere:sterling_boots, and the same trick makes galosphere:sterling_horse_armor.
Its selling point is EXPLOSION RESISTANCE, which is the reason to make it over iron.

Crystal shards come from galosphere:sparkle, crystallised lizards living in the canyons, in Allurite, Lumiere and plain variants. Right-click a sparkle's tail with a pickaxe to extract galosphere:allurite_shard or galosphere:lumiere_shard; it regrows in 5-10 minutes, and feeding it glow lichen speeds that up. Silk Touch yields a whole cluster instead of shards. They breed with glow lichen.
A sparkle regrows a DIFFERENT crystal type after each extraction, so it is a renewable farm rather than a one-off.
gates: No hard progression gates were described. The only real prerequisite is finding a Crystal Canyon, since the sparkles and the crystal blocks exist nowhere else.
traps: galosphere:palladium_bomb only destroys LOW blast-resistance blocks - it is not a mining tool for stone, and a quest promising excavation with it would mislead.

The 'elusive' status effect from the aura block obfuscates your health, hunger and inventory bars - the health bar stays visually constant while you are actually taking damage. Genuinely dangerous to stand near without knowing.

Everything below the guide's 1.19 coverage is UNVERIFIED for 1.20.1. The jar contains a whole later feature set the video never mentions: galosphere:opal, galosphere:pink_salt, galosphere:monstrometer, galosphere:mining_pouch, galosphere:saltbound_tablet, galosphere:rope_dart, galosphere:preserved_flesh, galosphere:spectre_bound_spyglass, galosphere:bottle_of_spectre, galosphere:echo_bell. None of these are sourced from any guide I captured.
signature: galosphere:palladium_ingot and the galosphere:sterling_chestplate set - the smithing-table-on-leather recipe is the mod's most distinctive craft.
galosphere:sparkle - a renewable, milkable crystal mob; the mod's best idea.
galosphere:allurite_shard and galosphere:lumiere_shard, plus galosphere:allurite_block and galosphere:lumiere_block.
galosphere:warped_anchor - charge it with an allurite block for 4 uses; an ender pearl landing nearby teleports you to the anchor instead.
galosphere:combustion_table - upgrades a galosphere:palladium_bomb with slimeballs (bouncier), string (longer fuse) or gunpowder (bigger blast), each to a max of level 3.
galosphere:lumiere_composter - right-click a part-filled composter with galosphere:lumiere_shard and it yields glowstone dust when full.
galosphere:charged_lumiere_block - what a galosphere:lumiere_block becomes when lightning strikes it.
